title: 29.x: Removing the restriction of deploying Power BI reports only to evaluation companies
summary: Power BI report deployment is no longer limited to evaluation companies; deploying to My workspace still is. The setup wizard now lets you pick a workspace, and the workspace name is recorded at deployment time and shown in the deployments list.
key_points: Evaluation company restriction removed for Power BI deployment
Workspace selection integrated into the deployment wizard
Workspace names tracked and displayed in deployment history
My workspace deployment still limited to evaluation companies
quote: Workspace selection is included in the wizard; Workspace name is tracked at deployment time
